faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: Sanskriti’s undated scholarship policy describes general categories including sports, defence, girls and disability. Its published conditions limit awards to tuition, allow one scheme at a time and require academic continuation without back papers. Agriculture applicants should obtain a dated programme-specific award; engineering and MBA merit tables are not agriculture entitlements. General-category scholarship conditions (undated): The page lists defence, girls, disability and sports categories, with supporting-proof requirements. Only one scheme may apply, tuition-only limits and continuation conditions apply, and the stated exclusions include BAMS, BUMS, B.Sc. Nursing and Ph.D. Agriculture-specific current approval is still required.

faqs.question: How can I contact Sanskriti University about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800 120 2880. Published email: info@sanskriti.edu.in. Official admissions: https://www.sanskriti.edu.in/admissions/admission-procedure.php

faqs.question: What annual agriculture fee does Sanskriti publish for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The dated brochure lists INR 90,000 annually for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. This is not a full living-cost budget.

faqs.question: What annual agriculture fee does Sanskriti publish for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The dated brochure lists INR 90,000 annually for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. This is not a full living-cost budget.

faqs.question: Which 10+2 subject combinations are accepted?
faqs.answer: The 2026-27 brochure lists PCM, PCB or Agriculture, with a minimum 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: Does Sanskriti offer postgraduate agricultural study?
faqs.answer: The brochure lists two-year M.Sc. options in Agronomy and Horticulture.

faqs.question: What is the ecological farming centre?
faqs.answer: The school describes a centre working under PPDC/MSME guidance for training related to sustainable practices and mechanisation.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR entry automatically cover the M.Sc. programmes?
faqs.answer: No. The audited School of Agriculture row explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. Agronomy; M.Sc. Horticulture. The [courses and fees table](/university/sanskriti-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 4 years. An undergraduate agricultural science course with laboratory-based teaching described by the school.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. Agronomy at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 2 years. Specialist postgraduate study listed in the agriculture section of the brochure.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. Horticulture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 2 years. A separate postgraduate horticulture route in the same brochure.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 2026-27 brochure: 10+2 with PCM, PCB or Agriculture and at least 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Agronomy at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 2026-27 brochure: graduation in the relevant subject with at least 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. Horticulture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: 2026-27 brochure: graduation in the relevant subject with at least 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: ₹90,000 / year · 2026-27. Annual course fee in the 2026-27 brochure; semester payment is separately shown as INR 47,000. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. Agronomy at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: ₹70,000 / year · 2026-27. Annual course fee; additional charges must be checked. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. Horticulture at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: ₹70,000 / year · 2026-27. Annual course fee; additional charges must be checked. Included charges: Published tuition/course fee; additional charges must be checked separately.

faqs.question: How does admission to Sanskriti University work?
faqs.answer: Sanskriti publishes an admission-procedure page and links its application portal. Use the 2026-27 brochure for the programme-specific academic threshold and request the selection and document requirements for the intended course. Confirm the course: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake. Request the intake notice: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: School of Agriculture: B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: The school’s official account identifies subject laboratories and an ecological farming centre. Its description links the centre to training in sustainable farming and mechanisation; it does not document an identical practical timetable for every cohort.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: Agriculture subject laboratories: The school describes experiments supported by subject laboratories and technicians. Centre of Excellence on Ecological Farming: The centre is described as a training resource for students and farmers.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: Separate residential hostels: The university describes separate hostels for boys and girls, with cleaning and maintenance provision. A room offer and its applicable charges require written confirmation. Campus and hostel safety: Its infrastructure account describes a secured campus boundary and measures restricting unauthorised entry. Centre of Excellence on Ecological Farming: The centre is described as a training resource for students and farmers.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: Sanskriti’s undated scholarship policy describes general categories including sports, defence, girls and disability. Its published conditions limit awards to tuition, allow one scheme at a time and require academic continuation without back papers. Agriculture applicants should obtain a dated programme-specific award; engineering and MBA merit tables are not agriculture entitlements. General-category scholarship conditions (undated): The page lists defence, girls, disability and sports categories, with supporting-proof requirements. Only one scheme may apply, tuition-only limits and continuation conditions apply, and the stated exclusions include BAMS, BUMS, B.Sc. Nursing and Ph.D. Agriculture-specific current approval is still required.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: A current agriculture-specific placement report was not available in the checked material.

faqs.question: How can I contact Sanskriti University about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800 120 2880. Published email: info@sanskriti.edu.in. Official admissions: https://www.sanskriti.edu.in/admissions/admission-procedure.php

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for Sanskriti University?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://www.sanskriti.edu.in/admissions/admission-procedure.php; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
